data.name: Marked
data.detailed_description:
What is Marked?

Dust, blood, and lies. Salvation’s Edge, 1899 — a dying town where you’re a killer, a thief, and a fraud — handed a dead man’s badge and told to solve a murder. Do they deserve redemption? Do you? Or will everyone forever be MARKED?

Inspired by classic Click-and-Point adventures, Marked combines a riveting narrative with a realistic visual style. Immerse yourself in the gritty, raw main street and the majestic wilds of the American West as you uncover the darkness that lurks within Salvation Edge.

Features

Experience the classic feel of point-and-click adventure games, where every clue matters. Navigate Salvation’s Edge with intuitive interactions—examine crime scenes, collect key evidence, and piece together the mystery one click at a time.

Your choices shape Ben Mercer’s journey. Decisions, from interrogations to moral dilemmas, impact the story’s outcome. Will you uphold justice or let your past dictate your actions? Multiple endings ensure no two direct playthroughs are the same.

Beyond dialogue and deduction, put your wits to the test with hands-on environmental puzzles. Pick locks, reassemble torn documents, manipulate old safes, and uncover hidden compartments to expose Salvation’s darkest secrets.

Forge alliances or make enemies in this frontier town. Gain trust through dialogue and actions, unlocking unique character-driven side stories. Your relationship with the town will determine who stands by you when the truth comes to light.

Piece together evidence through an in-depth detective system. Compare clues, analyze crime scenes, and reconstruct events to uncover hidden motives. Choose how to confront suspects—coerce, manipulate, or outsmart them to get to the truth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / AMD RX 5700 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 SSD GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 / AMD RX 6800 XT (10GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 NVMe SSD GB available space
